title: Resolution affirming support for Canada and Canadian New Yorkers
summary: This resolution affirms the City Council's support for Canada, Canadian New Yorkers and the economic, energy and tourism ties between New York City and Canada amid US-Canada trade tensions. It cites Canada as one of the city's largest trading partners, the Champlain Hudson Power Express energy project, and a drop in Canadian tourism and spending in 2025. It calls for an end to hostile rhetoric and trade practices harming the relationship.
